components.name: Prometheus
components.quote: Thanos is a set of components that can be composed into a highly available Prometheus setup with long term storage capabilities.

components.name: Query layer
components.quote: Queriers are stateless and horizontally scalable instances that implement PromQL on top of the Store APIs exposed in the cluster.

components.name: Rule
components.quote: The rule node directly implements it on top of the Prometheus storage engine it is running.

components.name: Sidecar
components.quote: The sidecar implements the gRPC service on top of Prometheus' [HTTP and remote-read APIs]

components.quote: A store node acts as a gateway to block data that is stored in an object storage bucket.
